items.title: Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
items.summary: Horizontal, risk-based AI framework with staged application dates. Verify current consolidated text and subsequent amendments at EUR-Lex.

history.change: Published in the Official Journal; entered into force 20 days later.
First prohibitions and AI literacy provisions began to apply.

items.title: Consumer Protections for Artificial Intelligence (SB 24-205)
items.summary: Colorado statute establishing duties for developers and deployers of high-risk AI systems; consult official bill page for amendments and current dates.

items.regulator: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
items.title: Automated Employment Decision Tools (Local Law 144)
items.summary: Requires bias audits and notices for covered automated employment decision tools. Official regulator page includes rules and compliance guidance.

items.regulator: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
items.title: A pro-innovation approach to AI regulation: government response
items.summary: Government policy describing a context-specific, regulator-led framework; it is not a single AI statute.

history.change: Government published its response and implementation plan.

items.regulator: Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments
items.title: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services
items.summary: Interim measures governing public-facing generative AI services in China; source is the issuing authority.

history.change: Measures published by the CAC and partner agencies.

items.title: Act on the Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of AI-Related Technologies
items.summary: Japan’s AI promotion legislation establishes government coordination and policy duties. Refer to the official Cabinet Office page for current materials.

history.change: Act promulgated; general effective date followed in June 2025.
